Hi Martin — thanks for the PO and the VAT ID. Short answer: for B2B customers in the EU with a valid VAT registration outside Redwood's seller country, we normally issue the invoice without VAT and the customer self-accounts under the reverse-charge mechanism.

To proceed we need two things from you:
- a copy of your company registration or VAT certificate (for our records), and
- confirmation of the billing address and PO number to appear on the invoice (you've included PO 1234 which is great).

Once Finance validates the VAT ID (we use VIES and an internal check), we'll create the invoice net of VAT, put the standard reverse-charge statement on the invoice, and send it to you. Priyom (cc) will confirm payment instructions and whether we need a signed addendum in DocuSign for our records.

If you prefer Redwood to charge VAT up front and have it refunded later, we can discuss — but that adds steps and is not our default for EU B2B.

I'll loop in Priyom and Rishi to finalize.

Thanks,
